name: Overview
content: JW Marriott Hotel Bengaluru is a luxury 5-star hotel located at 24/1 Vittal Mallya Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India. Phone: +91-80-6620-0000. Email: jwmarriott.bengaluru@marriott.com. Total rooms: 285. Star rating: 5-star. Brand: JW Marriott. Chain: Marriott Bonvoy. Check-in: 3:00 PM. Check-out: 12:00 PM.

name: Deluxe Room
content: Category: Room. The Deluxe Room is an elegant and spacious room designed for the discerning traveler with contemporary decor and premium furnishings. Size: 465 sq ft. Floor: 3 to 7. Bed options: King or Twin. Max occupancy: 2 adults. View: City View. Price: Rs 8500 per night. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, 55-inch LED TV, mini bar, in-room safe, tea and coffee maker, rainfall shower, premium bath amenities, and 24-hour room service.

name: Premier Room
content: Category: Room. The Premier Room is an upgraded room with enhanced amenities offering a more elevated experience. Thoughtfully designed interiors with curated art and designer furnishings. Size: 530 sq ft. Floor: 8 to 12. Bed options: King or Twin. Max occupancy: 2 adults. View: City or Pool View. Price: Rs 11000 per night. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, 55-inch LED TV, mini bar, in-room safe, Nespresso machine, rainfall shower, bathtub, premium bath amenities, turndown service, and 24-hour room service.

name: Junior Suite
content: Category: Room. The Junior Suite is a generous suite with a separate living area ideal for extended stays or business travelers requiring extra space. Features luxurious decor and panoramic city views. Size: 750 sq ft. Floor: 13 to 17. Bed: King. Max occupancy: 2 adults and 1 child. View: Panoramic City View. Price: Rs 18000 per night. Amenities include separate living room, dining area, Wi-Fi, 55-inch LED TV, mini bar, in-room safe, Nespresso machine, walk-in closet, bathtub and separate shower, premium bath amenities, turndown service, 24-hour room service, and welcome amenity.

name: Executive Suite
content: Category: Room. The Executive Suite is a spacious suite with a full living room and dedicated workspace. Includes exclusive Executive Lounge access with complimentary breakfast and evening cocktails. Size: 1100 sq ft. Floor: 18 to 22. Bed: King. Max occupancy: 2 adults and 1 child. View: Panoramic City and Garden View. Price: Rs 30000 per night. Amenities include full living room, dining area, study, Wi-Fi, 65-inch LED TV, mini bar, in-room safe, Nespresso machine, walk-in closet, dual vanity bathroom, bathtub and rain shower, premium Bulgari bath amenities, turndown service, 24-hour room service, Executive Lounge access, complimentary breakfast, and evening cocktails.

name: JW Suite
content: Category: Room. The JW Suite is a flagship suite offering the ultimate luxury experience. Handpicked art collection, curated interiors, and butler service define this exceptional stay. Size: 1600 sq ft. Floor: 23 to 26. Bed: King. Max occupancy: 2 adults and 2 children. View: 360-degree Panoramic City View. Price: Rs 55000 per night. Amenities include expansive living room, formal dining area, private study, Wi-Fi, 75-inch OLED TV, personal bar, in-room safe, Nespresso and espresso machine, walk-in wardrobe, dual vanity, freestanding bathtub, multiple showers, premium Bulgari bath amenities, 24-hour butler service, daily turndown, 24-hour room service, Executive Lounge access, complimentary breakfast and dining, and personalized welcome amenity.

name: Presidential Suite
content: Category: Room. The Presidential Suite is the pinnacle of luxury at JW Marriott Bengaluru. An extraordinary suite that redefines opulence with bespoke furnishings and exclusive privileges. Size: 2800 sq ft. Floor: 27 to 28. Bed: King. Max occupancy: 4 adults. View: Full Panoramic City and Countryside View. Price: Rs 150000 per night. Amenities include private terrace, grand living room, formal dining room, home theater, private gym, full kitchen, 3 bathrooms, 24-hour dedicated butler, personalized concierge, all-inclusive dining, private check-in and check-out, complimentary airport transfers, 24-hour room service, Executive Lounge access, and complimentary minibar restocked daily.

name: Spice Kitchen
content: Category: Dining. Spice Kitchen is JW Marriott's signature all-day dining restaurant celebrating the diverse culinary traditions of India. Features live cooking stations across different regional cuisines. Cuisine: Indian. Hours: Breakfast 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM, Lunch 12:30 PM to 3:00 PM, Dinner 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Capacity: 180 covers. Dress code: Smart casual. Specialty dishes include regional Indian cuisine, live cooking stations, tandoor kebabs, biryanis, South Indian dishes, coastal seafood. Average cost: Rs 2500 per person. Reservations recommended. Private dining room available for up to 20 guests.

name: The Lounge
content: Category: Dining. The Lounge is an elegant lobby lounge offering light bites, afternoon tea, and artisan cocktails in a sophisticated setting. Perfect for business meetings or casual socializing. Cuisine: Continental and Asian. Hours: All day from 7:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Capacity: 80 covers. Specialty: High tea from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, artisan cocktails, premium spirits, freshly baked pastries, sandwiches, and sushi. Average cost: Rs 1800 per person. Walk-ins welcome. Live music on weekends.

name: Ricks Bar
content: Category: Dining. Ricks Bar is Bengaluru's iconic nightspot with a rich heritage. An energetic bar known for its vibrant atmosphere, themed nights, and extensive beverage menu. Cuisine: Cocktails and bar bites. Hours: 6:00 PM to 1:30 AM. Capacity: 120 covers. Specialty: Craft cocktails, signature drinks, imported spirits, draught beers, bar bites, and finger food. Average cost: Rs 2000 per person. Live DJ Wednesday to Saturday. Dress code: Smart casual.

name: Pool Deck
content: Category: Dining. Pool Deck offers an alfresco dining experience by the outdoor pool. Enjoy casual meals and refreshing drinks in a relaxed open-air setting. Cuisine: Light bites and continental. Hours: 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Capacity: 60 covers. Specialty: Salads, grills, sandwiches, mocktails, fresh juices, and poolside snacks. Average cost: Rs 1500 per person. Exclusive for hotel guests.

name: Executive Lounge
content: Category: Dining. The Executive Lounge is an exclusive retreat for Executive Suite and above guests offering complimentary food and beverages throughout the day. Cuisine: International buffet and snacks. Hours: 6:30 AM to 10:00 PM. Capacity: 50 covers. Complimentary breakfast, all-day snacks, and evening cocktails from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Exclusive for Executive Suite, JW Suite, and Presidential Suite guests. Business services available.

name: Outdoor Swimming Pool
content: Category: Amenity. The hotel features a stunning outdoor swimming pool offering a refreshing escape in a beautifully landscaped setting in the heart of the city. Hours: 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Length: 25 meters. Pool towels provided. Poolside service available. Dedicated pool attendants. Heated during winter months. Exclusive for hotel guests.

name: JW Fitness Center
content: Category: Amenity. The JW Fitness Center is a state-of-the-art 24-hour facility equipped with the latest cardio and strength training equipment. Open 24 hours. Equipment includes treadmills, ellipticals, stationary bikes, Technogym strength machines, free weights, and a functional training zone. Personal training sessions available. Complimentary for hotel guests. Fitness classes including yoga and Pilates are available on request.

name: Quan Spa
content: Category: Amenity. Quan Spa is an award-winning luxury spa offering holistic wellness treatments inspired by ancient Indian healing traditions combined with contemporary techniques. Hours: 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Treatments include Ayurvedic massages, Swedish massage, deep tissue massage, hot stone therapy, body wraps, facials, and hydrotherapy. Facilities include 8 treatment rooms, 2 couple suites, steam room, sauna, and relaxation lounge. Signature treatments: Abhyanga oil massage and Shirodhara. Average cost: Rs 5000 to Rs 15000. Advance booking recommended.

name: Business Center
content: Category: Amenity. The Business Center is a fully equipped 24-hour facility providing essential services for corporate travelers. Services include high-speed internet, printing, scanning, faxing, and secretarial services. Equipment includes Mac and PC workstations, high-resolution printers, A3 and A0 plotters. Private conference pods available for small meetings. Complimentary for hotel guests.

name: Concierge Services
content: Category: Amenity. The dedicated concierge team provides personalized assistance 24 hours a day to ensure a memorable stay. Services include airport transfers, car rental, restaurant reservations, sightseeing tours, event tickets, shopping assistance, cultural experiences, city tours, visa assistance, and courier services. Multilingual staff available.

name: Grand Ballroom
content: Category: Meeting and Events. The Grand Ballroom is the premier venue for large-scale events, weddings, and corporate galas in Bengaluru. Capacity: 800 guests banquet style, 1000 guests theatre style. Size: 8000 sq ft. Ceiling height: 18 ft. Features include state-of-the-art AV system, LED wall, air conditioning, pre-function area, private entrance, and bridal suite. No natural light. In-built stage. Breakout rooms available. Dedicated event planning team. Full catering provided by the hotel.

name: Convention Hall
content: Category: Meeting and Events. The Convention Hall is a versatile space ideal for conferences, product launches, and large corporate meetings. Capacity: 500 guests banquet style, 600 guests theatre style. Size: 5000 sq ft. Features include advanced AV system, multiple projection screens, simultaneous translation booths, breakout areas, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Suitable for hybrid events. Technical support team on-site. Full catering provided by the hotel.

name: Board Room
content: Category: Meeting and Events. The Board Room is an intimate and sophisticated space for executive meetings and high-level business discussions. Capacity: 16 to 20 guests. Size: 800 sq ft. Features include oval conference table, premium leather chairs, 75-inch interactive display, video conferencing system, and whiteboard. Natural light available. Includes dedicated butler, stationery, and catering. Ideal for board meetings and investor presentations.

name: Breakout Rooms
content: Category: Meeting and Events. The hotel offers 6 flexible breakout rooms for workshops, training sessions, and smaller meetings. Individual capacity: 20 to 40 guests. Sizes: 400 to 600 sq ft each. Features include AV equipment, whiteboards, modular furniture, and natural light in select rooms. Rooms can be combined for larger groups. Catering available on request.

name: Nearby Attractions
content: Category: Location. JW Marriott Bengaluru is centrally located near major business and leisure attractions. Cubbon Park: 0.5 km. Vidhana Soudha: 1 km. MG Road and Brigade Road shopping: 1 km. Lalbagh Botanical Garden: 3 km. UB City Mall: 0.8 km. Commercial Street: 2 km. Bengaluru Palace: 3 km. ISKCON Temple: 8 km. Nandi Hills: 60 km. Mysuru: 140 km.

name: Transportation
content: Category: Location. Kempegowda International Airport (BLR): 35 km, approximately 45 to 60 minutes by car. Krantivira Sangolli Rayanna Railway Station (Bengaluru City): 5 km. Majestic Bus Stand: 5 km. Closest Metro Station: Cubbon Park on the Purple Line, 0.5 km. The hotel provides airport transfers (chargeable), taxi booking, valet parking, and self-parking.

name: Check-in and Check-out
content: Category: Policy. Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Standard check-out time is 12:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and a surcharge may apply. Late check-out is subject to availability and a surcharge may apply. Minimum age for check-in: 18 years. Government-issued photo ID required. International passport required for foreign nationals.

name: Cancellation Policy
content: Category: Policy. Standard rate: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before arrival. Advance purchase rate: Non-refundable. Group bookings: 72-hour cancellation policy applies. No-show fee: First night's room rate will be charged. Modification requests are subject to availability and rate differences.

name: Pet and Smoking Policy
content: Category: Policy. Pets are not allowed on hotel premises. Service animals are permitted with documentation. Emotional support animals should be declared in advance. Smoking is not permitted in any indoor areas including guest rooms. Designated smoking areas are available on hotel grounds. A Rs 10000 deep cleaning fee will be charged for smoking in non-smoking areas.

name: Honeymoon Package
content: Category: Package. The Honeymoon Package is a romantic experience crafted for couples celebrating their honeymoon or special occasions. Inclusions: Deluxe Room or above accommodation, romantic room setup with flowers and candles, complimentary bottle of sparkling wine, couple's massage at Quan Spa for 60 minutes, candlelight dinner at Spice Kitchen, late check-out until 2:00 PM subject to availability. Starting price: Rs 18000 per night.

name: Business Travel Package
content: Category: Package. The Business Travel Package is tailored for the corporate traveler requiring convenience and productivity. Inclusions: Premier Room or above accommodation, complimentary breakfast, access to Business Center, high-speed Wi-Fi, one-way airport transfer, 10% discount on dining, late check-out until 2:00 PM subject to availability. Starting price: Rs 12000 per night.

name: Wellness Retreat Package
content: Category: Package. The Wellness Retreat Package is a rejuvenating experience focused on health and well-being. Inclusions: Deluxe Room or above accommodation, daily breakfast, 90-minute Quan Spa treatment, daily yoga session, healthy meal at Spice Kitchen, access to Fitness Center. Starting price: Rs 20000 per night.
